sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions, and stops the GIF keyboard from sending your advertising ID, device model, carrier and screen size with its ad requests. Also removes the ad ID and ad services permission…

Unlocks Pro on your phone (every premium feature, no ads), keeps the trial from expiring, stops the Play license check from closing the app, and stops the ad SDKs from starting so they cannot load ads in the background.
